title: {Syn} Distillation Teaches Small Models From Large Ones
content:
Knowledge distillation trains a smaller student model to imitate signals from a larger teacher model. The student may learn from soft probabilities, generated answers, or curated traces.

The goal is often to keep useful behavior while reducing latency, memory, and deployment cost.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
